## Interpretation

For equal half-block sizes, `K_right - K_left` should be roughly half
of the adjacent block discrepancy.  A ratio near `0.5` confirms that
the observed prefix drift is ordinary block averaging.  The bin rows
then identify whether the drift is concentrated in return-depth tails,
bit-growth tails, or broad low-depth movement.
